_todo.description: Session task list. '- [x] done' / '- [ ] pending', one per line. Update each call. Empty string if unused.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel ID (for channel and channel_* operations)

country.description: Optional country code for feed-style operations

language.description: Optional language code for feed-style operations

playlist_id.description: YouTube playlist ID (for playlist and playlist_info operations)

post_id.description: YouTube community post ID (for post and post_comments operations)

query.description: Search query (for search, suggest, shorts, and channel_search operations)

url.description: YouTube URL (for resolve operation)

video_id.description: YouTube video ID (for video, video_info, metadata, transcript, subtitles, comments, related, screenshot, shorts_info operations)

function.name: yepapi_amazon
function.description: Amazon product data via YepAPI: search products, get product details by ASIN, read reviews, browse deals and best sellers. All operations are read-only and pay-per-call.

_todo.description: Session task list. '- [x] done' / '- [ ] pending', one per line. Update each call. Empty string if unused.

asin.description: Amazon ASIN product ID (for product, reviews, product_offers operations)

category.description: Category slug or browse node ID (for products_by_category, deals, best_sellers operations)

limit.description: Max results to return where supported (default: endpoint-specific)

seller_id.description: Amazon seller ID (for seller and seller_reviews operations)

sort_by.description: Review sort order: 'TOP_REVIEWS' or 'MOST_RECENT' (for reviews operation)

function.name: yepapi_instagram
function.description: Instagram data via YepAPI: search users/hashtags/places, get user profiles, posts, reels, comments, and hashtag posts. All operations are read-only and pay-per-call.
